raw:
Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: They treated an authentication failure (401/invalid OAuth token) as if it were valid data and reported “0 edits,” instead of recognizing and fixing the auth issue or using the public, unauthenticated MediaWiki Action API for read-only revision data. Their code also misused the API by adding a Bearer token where none is needed and failed to implement pagination/continuation for revisions. This misinterpretation and faulty approach led directly to the wrong result and blocked obtaining the true edit count.
